calls.title: Mozz Qureshi and August Allard
calls.summary: The meeting detailed a troubleshooting process for a vague customer support issue regarding GrowthBook’s self-hosted SDK. M Q outlined an initial diagnostic framework centered on flag evaluations and experiment hypotheses, identifying an incorrect SDK key as a root cause and guiding the customer to replace it. An 'invalid API host' error was resolved by correcting the API host configuration in the customer's Docker setup. Furthermore, the flow of user data from the SDK to Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and BigQuery was explored, revealing missing user-specific data despite experiment logs being visible. M Q emphasized a research-first approach to support, collaboration with colleagues, and a customer-oriented philosophy, while also discussing GrowthBook's hiring values and onboarding process.
calls.keywords: SDK troubleshooting, Experimentation, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), BigQuery integration, Customer support process, Onboarding experience
